name: Command stronghold (Atlantic Wall)
description: Atlantic Wall command stronghold, a 41 x 21 m reinforced-concrete block (about 60 x 34 m with its earthworks): 1.6 m front and 1.2-1.4 m side and rear walls with stepped MG and gun embrasures, a 1.6 m roof slab with rounded lips, shuttering-board imprint and lift joints, ochre-green-brown camouflage paint, run-off stains, a spalled corner with bent rebar. Earth banks bury the flanks and the rear to the roof and grass the rear half of the roof; a sunken rear entrance between retaining walls. Inside: gas lock and guard room behind two steel doors, a 37 m corridor, command room, radio room, observation post with a periscope, generator room, ammunition store, two crew quarters and three fighting rooms (west and east MG casemates with front and flank embrasures, a central gun room); a stair rises to the armoured observation cupola on the roof, whose steel door opens onto a railed roof deck with an MG nest, an aerial mast and concrete steps down the east bank.
